name: Carton Opener

liftToOpen.label: Lift to open (m)
liftToOpen.desc: How high the blank's centre has to rise above the table before it is fully open. Between the table and here it opens a step at a time.

standHeight.label: Stand height (m)
standHeight.desc: Height of the table top above the floor. The legs run from here to the floor.

frameColor.label: Frame color
frameColor.desc: Paint of the table and legs.

showBeam.label: Show beam
showBeam.desc: Draw the beam that reads how high the blank is.
